name: CoinTrader
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the Blockchain Graveyard label and description.
rootCause: Not much data available, other than that it has completely shut down after a suspected breach. This issue is currently under investigation and it is our intention to have the balance of your account settled as soon as possible. We sincerely apologize for this unfortunate inconvenience and will keep you posted on the progress of this issue. In the meantime, we have halted deposits, withdrawals and trading activity until this matter has been resolved.
